Jonah: oh my god that face :laughing: tiny criminal energy

Sam: is that a crumb in her whiskers?? :heart_eyes:
Lena: who do we call to register an otter as official office hazard? @Maya keep the receipt for evidence
Priya: quick psa — double-check cupcake ingredients before regular treats (sugar x otter)
Maya: vet said a tiny lick is ok, then gave her tuna as restitution :fish:
Jonah: would 100% serve on the jury for the trial of the century
Maya: adding metadata: `paw_size=3cm` and `frosting_spread=1.2cm` (scientific)
PhotoBot: reaction :thumbsup: from 4 people
Sam: this is my new morning morale boost, thank you Clementine
Maya: she finally surrendered when I promised extra swim time — nap photos next
Maya: https://images.example.com/clementine_nap.jpg
Lena: floof level: MAX :melting_face:
Priya: can we get a Clementine calendar pls
Jonah: seconded. @Maya sell prints and give dev discount
Sam: mandatory poll suggestion: cupcakes (illegal) vs tuna (rehab) :poll:
Maya: quick tally — cupcakes (illegal): 2, tuna (rehab): 5
Maya: thanks for the hype everyone :heart: — will archive under "Clementine Corner" for later blackmailing
